column1: # opcode -> subsystem, from the CLASS PREFIXES of its named senders in
# payload_layouts.tsv. An opcode appears only when every named sender agrees.
# strength = how many named senders carry that prefix; 1 is a lead, not a finding.
# Generic module attributions (GObjPC, CGObjPC, CMainProcess, CGameServer) are
# excluded -- they say where a function lives, not which subsystem owns the opcode.
